archive_command: git init && git remote add origin <url> && git fetch --depth 1 origin <revision> && git archive --format=tar --prefix=uuid/ FETCH_HEAD

build_script.note: no build.rs and no [build-dependencies] in the published package (include = src, README, licences); rng/, tests/, examples/ and fuzz/ are separate workspace crates the Oracle never installs

tag_peel: refs/tags/v1.26.0 resolves directly to the frozen commit (lightweight tag: v1.26.0^{} returns no peeled object)
